method: Batch 50 (legacybody): the batch 49 piston harness (b49po: pistons push the mob, the player stands far away, the tile loop after every entity) with the mobs whose EntityLiving.isAIEnabled (sw.bk) is false and that had no record (silverfish, giant, zombie pigman, blaze) and, as AI-enabled controls, a witch and a creeper: a push east, north and into a wall, and a retracting block. Row element 8 of a mob holds motion, yaw, pitch, head yaw and body yaw offset per tick; element 9 lists the moving tiles. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
